ihra.title: IHRA Working Definition of Antisemitism
ihra.locator: Definition, contextual introduction and illustrative examples; current official-page retrieval blocked.
ihra.exclusions: Non-legally binding; examples require overall context; policy criticism similar to other countries is not automatically antisemitic.
ihra.coverage: DOXA's three criteria are a partial operational summary, not the complete working definition.

jda.title: Jerusalem Declaration on Antisemitism
jda.locator: Definition; General guidelines 1–5; Israel/Palestine guidelines 6–15; FAQ on legal use.
jda.exclusions: Guidelines must be read together in context; political positions are not inherently antisemitic; not designed as a legal/quasi-legal speech code.
jda.coverage: Three operational criteria retain the political-expression boundary but do not replace all fifteen guidelines.

nexus.title: The Nexus Document
nexus.locator: What Is Antisemitic? 2–4,7–9; What Is Not Antisemitic? 1,3–5; June 2024 update.
nexus.exclusions: Political opposition and disproportionate attention are not prima facie proof; standards and source context matter.
nexus.coverage: Three operational criteria; no vote across frameworks and no legal determination.

anti-muslim-hostility.title: A Definition of Anti-Muslim Hostility
anti-muslim-hostility.locator: Section 6 paragraphs 1–3 and protected-expression list; section 8 notes on use.
anti-muslim-hostility.exclusions: England; non-statutory; no change to criminal/equality law; criticism/ridicule of religion protected; required intent/unlawfulness cannot be presumed.
anti-muslim-hostility.coverage: Three textual operational criteria cannot establish every legal/contextual condition from one passage.

anti-muslim-racism.title: Islamophobia: towards a working definition
anti-muslim-racism.locator: PDF p4/printed p3 recommendation; PDF pp5–7 racialization; pp7–10 institutional/structural effects; p12/printed p11 free speech; p14/printed p13 recommendation.
anti-muslim-racism.exclusions: Protect Muslims/perceived Muslims rather than immunize Islam or governments from criticism; structural effects need not require deliberate intent; a paragraph does not establish a population-level pattern.
anti-muslim-racism.coverage: Partial operationalization. Intersectionality, policy evidence and comparable outcomes require additional evidence. Full PDF is linked, not redistributed.

review_scope: Decision-oriented source review, not a systematic literature review or independent model validation.
